title: Why Japanese Streets Often Have No Sidewalks
seo_title: Why Japanese Streets Often Have No Sidewalks
description: Many Japanese residential streets have no raised sidewalk—only a white line or shared pavement. Learn why older street widths, cars, and walking culture produced this landscape, and how visitors can walk it more safely.
